items.title: DoorDash Cuts Grocery Reorder Latency from 16 to 2 Seconds with AI Agents
items.summaryShort: DoorDash Cuts Grocery Reorder Latency from 16 to 2 Seconds with AI Agents. DoorDash reduced grocery reorder latency from 16 to 2 seconds by precomputing recurring purchase needs using batch LLM inference and deterministic validation.

items.summaryShort: Netflix Titus Adds Single-Tenant VM Isolation for Containers. Netflix has added single-tenant Titus, a mode that runs one task alone on its own right-sized EC2 instance.
